cases.title: Reproduce blank OAuth callback
preconditions: Connected unlocked tablet; account login for authenticated cases
assertions: Retained tablet had an empty handleAllianceLogin document; AGC APIs returned 401. Four stale host-only authentication cookies coexisted with fresh domain cookies.
failureSignals: Blank document, stale content, repeated login loop
